svg.title: Seneca's three tenses, as the console's overview draws them
svg.desc: Three cards. Quod fuit, what ran: the runs, the success rate, and each run's own logs. Quod est, what is running: the DAG with each step's state, live. Quod futurum est, what is next: the scheduled slots and the backfill you asked for. Seneca, De Brevitate Vitae X.2: life is divided into three times, what was, what is, what will be.
